A bottle is sitting on the table.

score_events.observation:
Kitchen
You are in the kitchen of the white house. A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food. A passage leads to the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward. A dark chimney leads down and to the east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
  A quantity of water

The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.

Cellar
You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading north, and a crawlway to the south. On the west is the bottom of a steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.

positives: Prioritize interactions that produced an observed score increase; revisit them only when the context supports it.
Continue exploring newly discovered locations and recording their transitions in the persistent map.
Use Jericho score deltas as feedback rather than relying only on whether an action sounds promising.
Use score changes and environment responses as concrete feedback for choosing subsequent actions.
Inspect unfamiliar rooms and objects before committing to a long sequence of movement commands.
Record successful transitions and useful environmental clues so later decisions can reuse them.
Verify that a proposed route works one transition at a time before relying on it.
negatives: Avoid repeating an unsuccessful command without a new clue, item, or change in circumstances.
Do not treat remembered routes, inventory guesses, or puzzle hypotheses as confirmed facts.
Avoid exploring without a concrete short-term objective when a score opportunity or unresolved obstacle is already evident.
Do not continue a route after the environment has shown that its next transition is blocked.
Do not assume that a movement command returns to the room from which the player came.
Avoid abandoning a potentially useful object without first examining its description or behavior.
Do not confuse an Actor-reported inventory guess with an environment-verified inventory state.

score_events.observation:
Kitchen
You are in the kitchen of the white house. A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food. A passage leads to the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward. A dark chimney leads down and to the east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
  A quantity of water

You have moved into a dark place.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.

It is pitch black. You are likely to be eaten by a grue.

positives: Prioritize interactions that produced an observed score increase; revisit them only when the context supports it.

score_events.observation:
Kitchen
You are in the kitchen of the white house. A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food. A passage leads to the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward. A dark chimney leads down and to the east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
  A quantity of water

You have moved into a dark place.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.

It is pitch black. You are likely to be eaten by a grue.

Kitchen

On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
  A quantity of water

You have moved into a dark place.

It is pitch black. You are likely to be eaten by a grue.

Kitchen
You are in the kitchen of the white house. A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food. A passage leads to the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward. A dark chimney leads down and to the east is a small window which is open.

  A quantity of water

The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.

Cellar

score_events.observation:
Kitchen
You are in the kitchen of the white house. A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food. A passage leads to the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward. A dark chimney leads down and to the east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
  A quantity of water

The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.

Cellar
You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading north, and a crawlway to the south. On the west is the bottom of a steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.

episodes.historian_review: The Actor earned 30 points by successfully executing three known score‑positive actions: moving west from Behind House into the Kitchen (+10), going down in the Living Room (+25), and moving east in the Troll area (+5). These decisions show the Agent can still exploit previously discovered scoring opportunities when the preconditions are met. After obtaining the points, however, the Actor spent the majority of the episode wandering through the Dam, Deep Canyon, and Reservoir South area, repeatedly trying to find a way back to the Living Room without ever confirming a return route or securing any treasures. The Agent frequently entered dark locations without a light source, risking grue attacks, and became trapped in loops where the same south‑from‑Dam action was retried many times without any change in observation or score.

positives: Move west from Behind House to the Kitchen to collect points
Go down in the Living Room to gain points
Move east in the Troll area to earn points
Systematically test exits to map unfamiliar regions
Attempt to establish a return route to the Living Room before deep exploration
Recover dropped items to restore inventory and tool availability
Vary direction choices to break out of repetitive loops
negatives: Repeatedly moving south from Dam to Deep Canyon without observing any progress
Entering dark areas (e.g., the cellar after 'down') without ensuring a light source
Failing to verify a reliable return route to the Living Room before proceeding with extensive underground exploration
Ignoring inventory objects that could provide illumination or other utilities
Becoming trapped in a loop among Dam, Deep Canyon, and Reservoir South with no score change
Not banking any treasures or revisiting known score‑positive locations after initial gains
Continuing to retry the same blocked actions after they have repeatedly produced no effect

score_events.observation:
Kitchen
You are in the kitchen of the white house. A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food. A passage leads to the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward. A dark chimney leads down and to the east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
  A quantity of water

You have moved into a dark place.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.

It is pitch black. You are likely to be eaten by a grue.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.

East-West Passage
This is a narrow east-west passageway. There is a narrow stairway leading down at the north end of the room.

score_events.observation:
Kitchen
You are in the kitchen of the white house. A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food. A passage leads to the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward. A dark chimney leads down and to the east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
  A quantity of water

You have moved into a dark place.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.

It is pitch black. You are likely to be eaten by a grue.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.

score_events.observation:
Kitchen
You are in the kitchen of the white house. A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food. A passage leads to the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward. A dark chimney leads down and to the east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
  A quantity of water

You have moved into a dark place.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.

It is pitch black. You are likely to be eaten by a grue.

score_events.observation: Taken.

Kitchen
You are in the kitchen of the white house. A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food. A passage leads to the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward. A dark chimney leads down and to the east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
  A quantity of water

You have moved into a dark place.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.

It is pitch black. You are likely to be eaten by a grue.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.

score_events.observation:
Kitchen
You are in the kitchen of the white house. A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food. A passage leads to the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward. A dark chimney leads down and to the east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
  A quantity of water

You have moved into a dark place.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.

It is pitch black. You are likely to be eaten by a grue.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.

East-West Passage
This is a narrow east-west passageway. There is a narrow stairway leading down at the north end of the room.

episodes.historian_review:
The Actor earned points by moving west from Behind House into the Kitchen (+10), going down from the Living Room into the Cellar (+25), and moving east from the Troll area into the East‑West Passage (+5). These actions were the only score‑changing events and demonstrate that the Actor can follow known score‑positive directions when they are available. The Actor also systematically explored many locations, picked up useful items (sword, lantern, wrench, tube, matchbook), and early on set a strategic goal to establish a return route to the Living Room before venturing deeper underground.

However, the Actor repeatedly became trapped in a loop among the Dam, Deep Canyon, and Reservoir South, attempting the same south‑from‑Dam‑to‑Deep‑Canyon action many times without any score change or new progress. After entering the dark Cellar the Actor delayed lighting the lantern, risking a grue encounter, and never verified a reliable return route before exploring the Troll, Chasm, and Dam areas. Consequently, no treasures were banked, and known score‑positive locations were not revisited for additional points. For the next episode, the Actor should secure a confirmed return route to the Living Room before deep exploration, use light sources immediately upon entering dark areas, bank any valuables as soon as they are obtained, and break out of repetitive loops by trying novel directions or actions rather than repeating futile moves.
